title: Video editor: Robust Video Matting (RVM, mobilenetv3, ONNX fp32) - steady, fast background removal for video on the GPU node
license_note: RVM (PeterL1n/RobustVideoMatting, release v1.0.0) is GPL-3.0. It is used here only inside this node, on the owner's own computer, to cut the subject out of the owner's own videos; the model file is not redistributed or linked into any product. ~14.3 MB. It runs through onnxruntime (CUDA when the card is usable, else CPU) - no other download is needed besides numpy + onnxruntime in some Python of this computer (the node never installs them by itself; without them the older per-frame BiRefNet path is used). The first URL is the site's own mirror (the line to GitHub is slow or blocked); the second is the original release asset, same bytes (sha256 checked either way). Photo matting (agent 2.7): u2netp and IS-Net general use are Apache-2.0, BiRefNet-lite is MIT; they are optional packages (matting-u2netp, matting-isnet, matting-runtime) fetched on request or by the panel's scheduled download, and run only on this node.

packages.video-matting: Robust Video Matting mobilenetv3 fp32 (ONNX, 14 MB) - video background removal
packages.matting-u2netp: u2netp (U2-Net small, 5 MB) - photo background removal
packages.matting-isnet: IS-Net general use (170 MB) - photo background removal
packages.matting-runtime: onnxruntime-directml + numpy + Pillow in a small environment of its own - only when no Python here has onnxruntime
